d: Palash brand ka harbal gulal jharkhand rajy gramin aajivika mishan (JSLPS) ki 'sakhi mandal' ki mahilaon dvara prakritik phulon aur vanaspatiyon se taiyar kiya jata hai. yah puri tarah se rasayan-mukt aur tvacha ke lie surakshit hai. ise mukhy rup se palash (tesu) ke phulon, genda, gulab, chukandar aur haldi jaise prakritik sroton se banaya jata hai. visheshagyon ke anusar, ismen kisi bhi hanikarak sinthetik rang ka upyog nahin hota, jisse yah bachchon aur sanvedanshil tvacha valon ke lie bhi upyukt hai. sath hi, yah puri tarah se iko-phrendli hai aur aasani se dhul jata hai.
